notes.title: Population Goals! is Preparing to Launch!!
notes.content:
[h2]Population Goals! will be releasing on September 23rd[/h2]
[i]Wishlist so you won't miss it and try the Demo now to see if it's a good fit![/i]

I have really enjoyed the process of creating this game and I hope you'll enjoy playing it just as much. It is a combination of different game types that I enjoy, crafting/mining and lemmings style games. Combined with the story I think this will make a fun and unique experience. Join the Discord to let us know what you think.

Long live old earth!

notes.title: Explosive Demo Update
notes.content: The demo now includes the first[b] explosive[/b] and [b]drone [/b]in the game as well as a look at the first few [b]crafts[/b]! There is also a major update to the [b]lighting [/b]system as well. [i]Start a new game[/i] in the demo to experience these additional features and updates. As always, thanks for checking out the demo, work continues on the full game we are hoping to release by Q4!
